# String Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [ToUpper](/docs/standard-library/string/toupper) | Converts text to upper case. |
| [ToLower](/docs/standard-library/string/tolower) | Converts text to lower case. |
| [Trim](/docs/standard-library/string/trim) | Removes white space from both ends of text. |
| [Replace](/docs/standard-library/string/replace) | Replaces every occurrence of one piece of text with another. |
| [Contains](/docs/standard-library/string/contains) | Tells whether a string holds a piece of text, or an array holds a value. |
| [StartsWith](/docs/standard-library/string/startswith) | Tells whether text begins with a given prefix. |
| [EndsWith](/docs/standard-library/string/endswith) | Tells whether text ends with a given suffix. |
| [Split](/docs/standard-library/string/split) | Splits text into an array of parts at each occurrence of a separator. |
| [Join](/docs/standard-library/string/join) | Joins the elements of an array into one string, with a separator between each two. |
| [Substring](/docs/standard-library/string/substring) | Takes part of text, from a start position, of a given length or to the end. |
| [ToNumber](/docs/standard-library/string/tonumber) | Reads a number from text written as a JSON number. |
| [PadLeft](/docs/standard-library/string/padleft) | Pads text on the left to a given length. |
| [PadRight](/docs/standard-library/string/padright) | Pads text on the right to a given length. |
| [RegexTest](/docs/standard-library/string/regextest) | Tells whether a regular expression matches anywhere in text. |
| [RegexMatch](/docs/standard-library/string/regexmatch) | Finds the first match of a regular expression in text. |
| [RegexMatchAll](/docs/standard-library/string/regexmatchall) | Finds every match of a regular expression in text. |
| [RegexMatchDetail](/docs/standard-library/string/regexmatchdetail) | Finds the first match of a regular expression in text, with its position and its capture groups. |
| [RandomString](/docs/standard-library/string/randomstring) | Makes a string of random characters. |
